sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会上，在现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选访谈，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过它的。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, federal courts keep rejecting President Trump's attempts to ask about citizenship on the 2020 census.
sentences.zh: 今天，联邦法院不断驳回特朗普总统在2020年人口普查中询问公民身份的企图。

sentences.en: Why, no matter what the courts decide, the president may already have achieved his goal.
sentences.zh: 为什么无论法院如何裁决，总统可能已经实现了他的目标。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月11日，星期四。

sentences.en: The latest battle between Democrats and the Trump administration is over a question.
sentences.zh: 民主党人与特朗普政府之间的最新较量围绕着一个问题展开。

sentences.en: Are you a United States citizen?
sentences.zh: 你是美国公民吗？

sentences.en: Commerce Department on Monday announced the upcoming 2020 census will include that question for the first time since 1950.
sentences.zh: 商务部周一宣布，即将进行的2020年人口普查将自1950年以来首次包含这个问题。

sentences.en: You know, critics are saying it's basically the perfect way for the Trump administration to target immigrants and perhaps then lead to less resources in immigrant communities.
sentences.zh: 你知道，批评人士说，这基本上是特朗普政府针对移民的完美方式，或许随后会导致移民社区资源的减少。

sentences.en: What do we want?
sentences.zh: 我们想要什么？

sentences.en: What do we want it?
sentences.zh: 我们什么时候想要？

sentences.en: Now!
sentences.zh: 马上！

sentences.en: The Justice Department says the data is needed to help enforce the Voting Rights Act.
sentences.zh: 司法部表示，这些数据是协助执行《选举权法》所必需的。

sentences.en: The New York Times reports at least 12 states plan to sue the Trump administration to block it from asking a citizenship question in the 2020 census.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，至少有12个州计划起诉特朗普政府，以阻止其在2020年人口普查中询问公民身份问题。

sentences.en: And we start with that breaking news from the Supreme Court just moments ago.
sentences.zh: 我们首先关注来自最高法院刚刚传出的突发新闻。

sentences.en: The high court ruling against the Trump administration's bid to add a citizenship question to the 2020 census.
sentences.zh: 最高法院裁决反对特朗普政府在2020年人口普查中加入公民身份问题的企图。

sentences.en: Despite the Trump administration's attempt to politicize the census and divide our nation, we, the people, prevailed.
sentences.zh: 尽管特朗普政府试图将人口普查政治化并分裂我们的国家，但我们，人民，取得了胜利。

sentences.en: So, Adam Lipsack, the last time we talked to you, you told us that you thought it was pretty likely that the Supreme Court would allow the Trump administration
sentences.zh: 那么，亚当·利普萨克，我们上次和你交谈时，你告诉我们你认为最高法院很有可能会允许特朗普政府

sentences.en: to add a question about citizenship to the census.
sentences.zh: 在人口普查中加入关于公民身份的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was quite confident the five conservatives in the majority of the Supreme Court would allow the Trump administration to add this question,
sentences.zh: 是的，我曾相当自信地认为，最高法院多数派中的五名保守派会允许特朗普政府加入这个问题，

sentences.en: which, of course, everybody agrees would suppress participation in the census, discourage both legal and unauthorized immigrants from answering.
sentences.zh: 当然，大家都同意这会压制人口普查的参与度，阻止合法和未取得合法身份的移民回答。

sentences.en: And when I came out of that argument, I felt pretty confident about that, and that's what I told you, and I turned out to be wrong.
sentences.zh: 当我走出那场法庭辩论时，我对此相当有信心，我当时也是这么对你说的，结果我错了。

sentences.en: It happens.
sentences.zh: 这种事时有发生。

sentences.en: You don't like it to happen, but this time there's a pretty plausible explanation of what happened after the argument that may have influenced the justices,
sentences.zh: 你当然不希望它发生，但这一次，对于辩论结束后可能影响大法官的事情，有一个相当合理的解释，

sentences.en: or at least one of them.
sentences.zh: 或者至少影响了其中一位。

sentences.en: And what was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: So, on May 30th, about a month after the argument, about a month before the decision, there's a revelation reported on by my colleague Michael Wines
sentences.zh: 因此，在5月30日，也就是辩论大约一个月后、裁决大约一个月前，我的同事迈克尔·温斯报道了一个重大内幕，

sentences.en: that lawyers for the challengers had gotten hold of some very interesting documents, and the way they got hold of them was kind of interesting, too.
sentences.zh: 挑战方的律师拿到了一些非常有趣的文件，他们获取这些文件的方式也挺有趣的。

sentences.en: A master Republican strategist, Thomas Hofeller, had died, and his estranged daughter, going through his materials and his computers and his hard drive,
sentences.zh: 一位资深的共和党策略师托马斯·霍费勒去世了，他疏远的女儿在翻看他的材料、电脑和硬盘时，

sentences.en: discovers these very interesting documents, contacts lawyers for the challengers, and all of a sudden, here they are on the court record.
sentences.zh: 发现了这些非常有趣的文件，她联系了挑战方的律师，突然之间，这些文件就出现在了法院记录中。

sentences.en: Those documents seem to show that there's at least reason to think that the administration was offering a false reason for adding the citizenship question to the census.
sentences.zh: 这些文件似乎表明，至少有理由认为政府为在人口普查中加入公民身份问题提供了一个虚假的理由。

sentences.en: It's always been a little puzzling why the Trump administration has said what it wanted to do, its reason for adding the question,
sentences.zh: 长期以来一直有点令人费解的是，特朗普政府所说它想做的事、它加入该问题的理由，

sentences.en: was that it wanted to better enforce the Voting Rights Act and more fully protect minority voters.
sentences.zh: 是它希望更好地执行《选举权法》并更充分地保护少数族裔选民。

sentences.en: That's not something you closely associate with the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 这可不是你通常会和特朗普政府联系在一起的事情。

sentences.en: So, that was always a questionable idea.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一直是一个值得怀疑的想法。

sentences.en: And these documents seem to give us the real reason.
sentences.zh: 而这些文件似乎向我们提供了真正的理由。

sentences.en: The real reason, according to this strategist, was that if you collect citizenship data,
sentences.zh: 据这位策略师称，真正的理由是，如果你收集公民身份数据，

sentences.en: you can allow states to draw voting districts in a way different from how they're currently drawn.
sentences.zh: 你就可以允许各州以与目前不同的方式划分选区。

sentences.en: Currently, you draw voting districts to have equal numbers of people in a district.
sentences.zh: 目前，你划分选区是为了让每个选区拥有相等的人数。

sentences.en: And those people can be eligible to vote, or they cannot be eligible to vote.
sentences.zh: 而这些人可以是有投票资格的，也可以是没有投票资格的。

sentences.en: They can be children, they can be prisoners, they can be unauthorized immigrants.
sentences.zh: 他们可以是儿童，可以是囚犯，可以是未取得合法身份的移民。

sentences.en: But one person, one vote under this conception, which is universally used today, is drawn based on equal numbers of people in voting districts.
sentences.zh: 但在这种普遍沿用的概念下，一人一票是根据选区中相等的人数来划分的。

sentences.en: The alternative idea, though, is to draw districts based only on eligible voters.
sentences.zh: 然而，另一种想法是仅根据符合条件的选民来划分选区。

sentences.en: And that would exclude unauthorized immigrants.
sentences.zh: 那将把未取得合法身份的移民排除在外。

sentences.en: But you'd need data to do that, and this data would get you there.
sentences.zh: 但你需要数据来实现这一点，而这些数据能帮你达到目的。

sentences.en: And if that were to happen, that would almost always, across the country, benefit Republicans.
sentences.zh: 如果真能如此，几乎在全国各地都会让共和党受益。

sentences.en: Because urban places with lots of immigrants, some of them on green cards, some of them wholly unauthorized, would drop in voting power.
sentences.zh: 因为拥有大量移民的城市地区——其中一些人持有绿卡，另一些人完全没有合法身份——其投票权将会下降。

sentences.en: So, this would be a big move for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对共和党人来说将是一个重大举措。

sentences.en: And this strategist himself said that the effect would be to help Republicans and non-Hispanic whites.
sentences.zh: 这位策略师自己也说过，其效果将是帮助共和党人和非拉美裔白人。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, drawing districts based on just eligible voters, which is this strategist's ultimate goal,
sentences.zh: 因此，仅根据符合条件的选民来划分选区，这就是这位策略师的最终目标，

sentences.en: allows you to disempower non-citizens who generally happen to live in Democratic areas.
sentences.zh: 这能让你剥夺通常恰好住在民主党地区的非公民的赋权。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And the second thing, though, in the documents is some sense that the offered reason, the asserted reason, ought to be a different rationale entirely,
sentences.zh: 不过，文件中的第二点是，人们觉得给出的理由、声称的理由本应完全是另一套说辞，

sentences.en: that the administration was seeking citizenship data to better enforce the Voting Rights Act and to protect minority voters.
sentences.zh: 即政府寻求公民身份数据是为了更好地执行《选举权法》并保护少数族裔选民。

sentences.en: And what was the connection between this deceased strategist, whose documents were found by his daughter, and the Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 这位已故策略师（其文件被女儿发现）与特朗普政府之间有什么联系？

sentences.en: It's a little bit of a dotted line.
sentences.zh: 这其中有一点模棱两可的联系。

sentences.en: But what's clear from the documents, and it's early days, and we only have partial information, but the strategist gives at least some of these documents to an advisor,
sentences.zh: 但从文件中可以清楚看出（虽然目前还处于早期阶段，我们只有部分信息），这位策略师将其中至少一些文件交给了威尔伯·罗斯——商务部长的一位顾问。

sentences.en: to Wilbur Ross, the Commerce Secretary.
sentences.zh: 商务部长威尔伯·罗斯，他是负责人口普查的官员。

sentences.en: Wilbur Ross, the Cabinet Secretary, who is in charge of the census.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 文件中的某些措辞出现在政府内部来回传阅的一些信件中。

sentences.en: And some of the language in the documents shows up in some letters transmitted back and forth within the administration.
sentences.zh: 因此，很显然，这个本来就很重要的人物至少参与了部分决策过程。

sentences.en: So, clearly, this guy, who was a big deal to begin with, had his hand in at least some part of the decision-making process.
sentences.zh: 所以，亚当，这似乎表明，正如许多人所怀疑的那样，特朗普政府真正的动机带有党派色彩。

sentences.en: So, Adam, this, it seems, reveals that the Trump administration's real motive here was, as many people suspected, partisan.
sentences.zh: 这是为了推进共和党的事业，但它认识到不能直接说出来。

sentences.en: It was about advancing the cause of the Republican Party, but that it recognized that it couldn't just come out and say that.
sentences.zh: 它需要一个听起来更精致的理由。

sentences.en: It needed a more sophisticated-sounding rationale.
sentences.zh: 而这位共和党策略师提供了一个。

sentences.en: And that this Republican strategist provided one.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 那接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, then what happens?
sentences.zh: 到了6月27日。

sentences.en: So, it's June 27th.
sentences.zh: 这是最高法院开庭期的最后一天。

sentences.en: It's the last day of the Supreme Court term.
sentences.zh: 美国最高法院今天上午非常忙碌。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们首先关注来自国家最高法院的一些突发新闻。

sentences.en: Supreme Court, very busy this morning.
sentences.zh: 法院正在宣布几项裁决。

sentences.en: We start with some breaking news from the nation's highest court.
sentences.zh: 关于人口普查的裁决是最后一项裁决。

sentences.en: The court is announcing several decisions.
sentences.zh: 接着出现了一个意外。

sentences.en: The census decision is the very last decision.
sentences.zh: 我们看到首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨代表多数派撰写意见书。

sentences.en: And there comes a surprise.
sentences.zh: 在裁决的开头，看起来就像我所预测的那样，政府将要赢了。

sentences.en: We have Chief Justice John Roberts writing for the majority.
sentences.zh: 他在几个要点上判决政府胜诉。

sentences.en: And in the beginning of the decision, it looks like what I would have predicted, that the administration is going to win.
sentences.zh: 他说他们没有违反宪法，

sentences.en: He rules for the administration on several points.
sentences.zh: 这个选举权的理由并非专断和反复无常，但是……

sentences.en: He says they didn't violate the Constitution,
sentences.zh: 法院裁定，特朗普政府为在人口普查中加入公民身份问题所作的解释用原话来说是“不充分的”。

sentences.en: that this voting rights rationale was not arbitrary and capricious, but...
sentences.zh: 在裁决的最后几页中，其措辞看起来有些拼凑，或许证明了他思想在最后关头发生了转变，他说，但你知道吗？

sentences.en: The court ruled that the Trump administration's explanation for adding a citizenship question to the census is, quote, insufficient.
sentences.zh: 政府输了，因为这听起来像是一个借口。

sentences.en: In the last pages of the decision, and in language that seems kind of thrown together, maybe evidence of a late-in-the-day switch on his thinking, he says, but you know what?
sentences.zh: 这是人为捏造的。

sentences.en: The administration loses, because this sounds like a pretext to me.
sentences.zh: 接着又说，我们不能忽视所做出的决定与给出的解释之间的脱节。

sentences.en: This is contrived.
sentences.zh: 他作出了不利于政府的裁决，至少是暂时的。

sentences.en: Then goes on to say that we cannot ignore the disconnect between the decision made and the explanation given.
sentences.zh: 他留出了一点点缝隙，仿佛在说，也许你们可以用不同的理由再来。

sentences.en: And he rules against the administration, at least provisionally.
sentences.zh: 然而出人意料的是，罗伯茨与最高法院的四位自由派成员一起，作出了不利于特朗普政府的裁决。

sentences.en: He leaves the door ajar a tiny bit to say, maybe you can come back with a different reason.
sentences.zh: 在这个关于威尔伯·罗斯是否值得信任、他是否在说实话的核心领域，

sentences.en: But lo and behold, Roberts, joined only by the four liberal members of the Supreme Court, rules against the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到美国首席大法官基本上称呼一位内阁官员为骗子。

sentences.en: In this very area of can Wilbur Ross be trusted, was he telling the truth?
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We have now the Chief Justice of the United States essentially calling a cabinet official a liar.
sentences.zh: 所以他把刚才你描述的一切都考虑进去了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，特朗普政府、

sentences.en: So he's taken into account everything you just described.
sentences.zh: 商务部长威尔伯·罗斯在动机问题上是不诚实的。

sentences.en: And he is saying, essentially, that the Trump administration,
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wilbur Ross, the Commerce Secretary, is being disingenuous about motivation.
sentences.zh: 他用六种不同的方式表达了这一点，虽然都很温和，但总体上非常具有杀伤力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 不过我必须说，裁决书通篇都没有讨论作为本体的这些策略师文件。

sentences.en: He says that six different ways, all of them mild, but collectively very damning.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们一直在谈论的这些文件明显是背景信息，每个人都知道它们，但它们并没有在判决中被提及。

sentences.en: But I should say, nowhere in the decision is there any discussion of these strategist documents as such.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Although these documents we've been talking about were plainly in the background and everyone knew about them, they're not mentioned in the decision.
sentences.zh: 但即使没有被提及，听起来你也认为它至少在一定程度上影响了罗伯茨的决定。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 我确实这么认为，因为除了5月下旬事态的发展之外，我不知道还有什么能解释4月的法庭辩论与6月的裁决之间语气的彻底转变。

sentences.en: But even though they weren't mentioned, it sounds like you think that it did at least in part influence Roberts' decision.
sentences.zh: 所以到头来，罗伯茨是在对特朗普政府说，法律是站在你们这边的。

sentences.en: I do think that because I don't know what else would explain the complete change in tone between the April argument and the June decision, except for the developments in late May.
sentences.zh: 你们本可以把这个关于公民身份的问题加进去。

sentences.en: So at the end of the day, is Roberts saying to the Trump administration, the law was on your side here.
sentences.zh: 只要你们当时给我们一个更可信、听起来更真实、前后一致的正当理由。

sentences.en: You could have included this question about citizenship.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If only you had given us a more believable, authentic-sounding, consistent justification.
sentences.zh: 我认为完全正确。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，首席大法官稍微留了一扇门。

sentences.en: I think that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 他没有驳回此案。

sentences.en: And the chief justice, as I say, leaves the door open a little bit.
sentences.zh: 他把它发回给相关机构，并暗示也许现在它们还能带着更好的理由卷土重来。

sentences.en: He doesn't dismiss the case.
sentences.zh: 亚当，我对此有点困惑，因为如果罗伯茨真的认为提交给法院的理由是拼凑出来的、是人为制造的，

sentences.en: He sends it back down to the agency and suggests that maybe even now they can come back with a better reason.
sentences.zh: 为什么他还要允许政府尝试寻找另一个案由？

sentences.en: Adam, I'm a little confused by this because if Roberts really thinks that the rationale that's been presented to the court is contrived, it's manufactured,
sentences.zh: 这难道不几乎注定会产生一个拼凑出来的理由吗？

sentences.en: why is he allowing the administration to try to make another case?
sentences.zh: 因为在这一点上，政府似乎热衷于逆向拼凑出一个这样做的解释。

sentences.en: Isn't that almost by definition going to produce a contrived rationale?
sentences.zh: 我完全理解你的意思。

sentences.en: Because at this point, the administration seems to be invested in kind of reverse engineering an explanation for doing this.
sentences.zh: 鉴于你必须四处搜寻一些不同于你之前向法院陈述的东西（并将其作为你唯一倚仗的理由），要说新的解释不会比旧的荒谬两倍，几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: I completely get what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 威尔伯·罗斯曾说过，他追求这一点纯粹是为了执行《选举权法》。

sentences.en: It's pretty hard to say that the new explanation won't be twice as contrived as the old one, given that you have to hunt around for something that's different
sentences.zh: 与此同时，至少可以想象的是，

sentences.en: from the one you've already presented to the court as the only thing you're relying on.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官罗伯茨希望给政府每一个机会，去证明是否存在某种潜藏的真实理由，

sentences.en: Wilbur Ross said he was solely pursuing this in order to enforce the Voting Rights Act.
sentences.zh: 只要他们从一开始就明确表达出来，也许是可以被接受的。

sentences.en: At the same time, it's at least conceivable,
sentences.zh: 我知道这希望渺茫，但这正是首席大法官留下的可能性，尽管这并不容易。

sentences.en: Chief Justice Roberts wants to give the administration every chance that there is some lurking authentic reason
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，迈克尔，在我看来，如果他们从一开始就说他们想做的是为那些想要以不同方式划分选举选区的各州提供信息，

sentences.en: that if they'd only just articulated from the get-go, may be acceptable.
sentences.zh: 我认为这行得通。

sentences.en: I know it's a long shot, but that was what the Chief Justice left open the possibility of, although it ain't easy.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这算什么问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, Michael, it seems to me that had they said from the start that what they wanted to do was provide information to states
sentences.zh: 关于如何划分选区，最高法院一直将这个问题悬而未决。

sentences.en: that wanted to draw election districts in a different way, I think that would fly.
sentences.zh: 就在2016年，大法官露丝·巴德·金斯伯格还说，好吧，你们不被强制要求根据合格选民来划分选区，

sentences.en: I don't know that that's a problem.
sentences.zh: 但我们并没有裁定你们不被允许根据合格选民来划分选区。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court has left that question open about how you draw districts.
sentences.zh: 过段时间再来找我们吧。

sentences.en: As recently as 2016, Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg says, well, you're not required to draw them based on eligible voters,
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们从一开始就这么做，我想它大概率就行得通了。

sentences.en: but we're not deciding that you're not allowed to draw them based on eligible voters.
sentences.zh: 而这种有趣且看起来有些业余的诉讼策略，结果却害了他们。

sentences.en: Come back to us later.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So had they done that from the start, I think it probably flies.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: And this interesting and sort of amateurish-looking litigation strategy turns out to hurt them.
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，甚至无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 现在你就可以。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，去看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 获取免费访问权限。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 获取免费访问权限。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 获取免费访问权限。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what does the Trump administration actually do with this ruling from Chief Justice Roberts?
sentences.zh: 那么，特朗普政府究竟打算如何处理首席大法官罗伯ッツ的这项裁决？

sentences.en: Well, now, Michael, the chaos starts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，现在混乱开始了。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: government will print the forms for the 2020 census without a question about citizenship.
sentences.zh: 政府将印制2020年人口普查的表格，其中不包含关于公民身份的问题。

sentences.en: What they do a few days later is come into a federal district court and say, we give up, game over.
sentences.zh: 几天后，他们的做法是走进联邦地区法院说，我们认输，游戏结束。

sentences.en: Justice Department lawyers told a federal judge on Tuesday the fight was over.
sentences.zh: 司法部律师周二对一名联邦法官表示，争端已经结束。

sentences.en: Alas, today, it looks like the Trump administration basically had to admit it was all a ruse and wave the white flag.
sentences.zh: 唉，今天看起来特朗普政府基本上不得不承认这一切都是个把戏，并举起了白旗。

sentences.en: Basically, we accept defeat.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们接受失败。

sentences.en: We accept defeat.
sentences.zh: 我们接受失败。

sentences.en: And Wilbur Ross issues a statement to that same effect.
sentences.zh: 威尔伯·罗斯也发表了类似内容的声明。

sentences.en: I respect the Supreme Court, but strongly disagree with its ruling regarding my decision to reinstate a citizenship question on the 2020 census.
sentences.zh: 我尊重最高法院，但强烈不同意其关于我决定在2020年人口普查中恢复公民身份问题的裁决。

sentences.en: The Census Bureau has started the process of printing the decennial questionnaires without the question.
sentences.zh: 人口普查局已经开始印制不包含该问题的十年期调查问卷。

sentences.en: And then the next day, Wednesday, July 3rd.
sentences.zh: 然后到了第二天，也就是7月3日，星期三。

sentences.en: The president is tweeting up a storm today.
sentences.zh: 总统今天发推文发个不停。

sentences.en: President Trump tweets out that all of this is fake.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统发推文称这一切都是假的。

sentences.en: We're absolutely moving forward, as we must, because of the importance of the answer to this question.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对会继续推进，正如我们必须做的那样，因为这个问题答案的重要性。

sentences.en: And it's not clear what the fake is, because the reporting is a perfectly accurate reflection of what people in court and what a cabinet official in a statement said.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚什么是假的，因为报道完美、准确地反映了法庭上的人以及内阁官员在声明中所说的话。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, the president said it's fake.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，总统还是说这是假的。

sentences.en: That tweet prompted a scramble at the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 这条推文引发了司法部的混乱。

sentences.en: They're now being instructed to go in an opposite direction and hunt up some kind of rationale nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 他们现在接到指示，要朝相反的方向前进，无论如何都要找出某种理由。

sentences.en: So the tweet comes out.
sentences.zh: 所以推文发布了。

sentences.en: A federal judge in Maryland promptly sets up a telephone conference call on the record because he wants to know what the hell is going on here.
sentences.zh: 马里兰州的一名联邦法官迅速在记录在案的电话会议上进行安排，因为他想知道这到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: And the Justice Department lawyers, to their credit, are perfectly candid about how confused they are.
sentences.zh: 值得赞赏的是，司法部的律师们对他们有多困惑直言不讳。

sentences.en: One of them, Joshua Gardner, says to the judge, what I told the court yesterday was absolutely my best understanding of the state of affairs
sentences.zh: 其中一位名叫约书亚·加德纳的律师对法官说，我昨天对法庭所说的话绝对是我对当前局势的最佳理解

sentences.en: and apparently also the Commerce Department's state of affairs, because you probably saw Secretary Ross issue the statement very similar to what I told the court.
sentences.zh: 显然也是商务部的局势，因为你可能看到罗斯部长发表了一份与我告诉法庭的内容非常相似的声明。

sentences.en: The tweet this morning was the first I had heard of the president's position on this issue, just like the plaintiffs and your honor.
sentences.zh: 今天早上的推文是我第一次听到总统在这个问题上的立场，就像原告和您阁下一样。

sentences.en: I do not have a deeper understanding of what that means at this juncture other than what the president has tweeted.
sentences.zh: 除了总统发推文的内容之外，我目前对这意味着什么没有更深刻的理解。

sentences.en: But obviously, as you can imagine, I am doing my absolute best to figure out what's going on.
sentences.zh: 但显然，正如你可以想象的那样，我正在竭尽全力弄清楚发生了什么。

sentences.en: So these lawyers are just as in the dark as everyone else.
sentences.zh: 所以这些律师和其他人一样一无所知。

sentences.en: Yeah, they've made representations to the court.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们向法庭作了陈述。

sentences.en: They're trying to do their level best to be candid and honest and good advocates.
sentences.zh: 他们正在尽最大努力做到坦率、诚实和成为优秀的辩护人。

sentences.en: And they have on their hands a very difficult client.
sentences.zh: 他们手头有一个非常难缠的客户。

sentences.en: The president?
sentences.zh: 总统？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, Adam, have these lawyers done what the president is asking, which is to come up with a new legal justification for including the question?
sentences.zh: 那么，亚当，这些律师是否按照总统的要求做了，也就是为包含这个问题提出新的法律依据？

sentences.en: These lawyers apparently were not able to do that.
sentences.zh: 这些律师显然没能做到这一点。

sentences.en: And we know that because on Sunday, the Justice Department announces something truly extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以知道这一点，是因为在周日，司法部宣布了一件真正非同寻常的事情。

sentences.en: It says it's swapping out the old lawyers for new lawyers.
sentences.zh: 它宣布将旧律师换成新律师。

sentences.en: Now, we don't know exactly what went on, but it's very hard to come to any conclusion but that they could not ethically pursue this case,
sentences.zh: 现在，我们不知道具体发生了什么，但除了他们无法在道义上继续推进这个案子之外，很难得出任何其他结论，

sentences.en: that they did not feel that there was a legally plausible justification rationale to go forward with.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得没有一个具有法律似真性的理由和依据来继续进行下去。

sentences.en: And perhaps they were fired, although it would be very odd to take off of your team the people who have been living with it for more than a year
sentences.zh: 也许他们被解雇了，尽管把那些已经跟进了一年多、

sentences.en: and who are the most sophisticated and knowledgeable people about a very complicated case and put in a bunch of newbies, much more likely they said, please take us off the case.
sentences.zh: 并且是对这个非常复杂的案件最熟悉、最有经验的人换掉，换上一群新手，这会非常奇怪；更有可能是他们说，请把我们的名字从这个案子上撤下来。

sentences.en: And Justice announces it's going to put new lawyers on the case.
sentences.zh: 司法部宣布将指派新律师接手此案。

sentences.en: So you think that these lawyers are basically saying, we won't sign our name to this anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以你认为这些律师基本上是在说，我们不会再在这个文件上署名了。

sentences.en: We will not defend the president's pursuit of this question on the census.
sentences.zh: 我们不会为总统在人口普查中追问这个问题的做法进行辩护。

sentences.en: We're done.
sentences.zh: 我们不干了。

sentences.en: That's my reading of it, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我是这么解读的，是的。

sentences.en: So how's it been going for these new lawyers?
sentences.zh: 那么这些新律师最近过得怎么样？

sentences.en: You know, we don't know yet.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们还不知道。

sentences.en: What we do know is that one judge in New York has said he's not going to let the old lawyers out of the case
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，纽约的一名法官表示，他不会让老律师退出此案

sentences.en: at least until they come up with, quote, satisfactory reasons for withdrawing.
sentences.zh: 至少在他们提出所谓令人满意的退出理由之前。

sentences.en: So now we have another little sideshow about whether the old lawyers are allowed to leave or not.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们又迎来了一场关于老律师是否被允许离开的小插曲。

sentences.en: And there is a local court rule in the federal district court in Manhattan that says you can't just jump off a case.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿联邦地区法院有一项地方庭审规则，规定你不能说不干就不干。

sentences.en: It's very disruptive.
sentences.zh: 这会造成极大的干扰。

sentences.en: And in this case in particular, it's more disruptive than most because everybody knows time is of the essence.
sentences.zh: 特别是这个案子，比大多数案子都更具干扰性，因为大家都知道时间就是金钱。

sentences.en: So it turns out that the Department of Justice is not allowed to switch lawyers in the middle of a case without explaining exactly why.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，司法部在不准确解释原因的情况下，是不允许在案件审理中途更换律师的。

sentences.en: And explaining exactly why, I presume, would be embarrassing if you're right that they quit in protest because they don't like how this has been handled.
sentences.zh: 我想，准确解释原因将会是非常尴尬的，如果你是对的，他们是因为不喜欢处理方式而抗议辞职的话。

sentences.en: Yep, that's the problem.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: So this is definitively not proceeding well for the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 因此，对特朗普政府来说，这绝对进展不顺利。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Whatever Chief Justice Roberts expected when, at the end of June, he ruled against the administration
sentences.zh: 无论首席大法官罗伯茨在6月底做出不利于政府的裁决时预期什么，

sentences.en: but suggested that maybe there's some kind of path forward, I do not think that this is what the Chief Justice bargained for.
sentences.zh: 但暗示可能某种前进的道路，我不认为这是首席大法官所期望的。

sentences.en: And I have to think that the Chief Justice, who was himself a senior Justice Department official and who prized the Justice Department's credibility in court,
sentences.zh: 我不得不认为，首席大法官本人曾担任司法部高级官员，并极为珍视司法部在法庭上的信誉，

sentences.en: will have very little patience for this chaotic scene we've seen over the past couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 对于我们在过去几周看到的这场混乱场景，他将失去耐心。

sentences.en: So I don't know that the administration had much of a shot in the wake of last month's decision.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道在经历了上个月的裁决之后，政府还有多大胜算。

sentences.en: But with each passing day, it really becomes quite remote that they could get five votes on the Supreme Court to sustain whatever new rationale they come up with.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，他们能否在最高法院获得五票来维持他们提出的任何新理由，真的变得微乎其微。

sentences.en: Why do you think the administration is fighting this so hard at this point, Adam?
sentences.zh: 亚当，你认为为什么政府现在还要如此拼命地反抗？

sentences.en: Why keep pursuing these strategies that seem very unlikely to actually succeed in putting this question on the census?
sentences.zh: 为什么还要继续推行这些看起来极不可能成功将这个问题加入人口普查的策略？

sentences.en: Well, there are two reasons.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有两个原因。

sentences.en: I think one of them is political.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一个是政治原因。

sentences.en: The president doesn't like to lose, would rather fight and show his base how committed he is to these issues, even at the expense of an ultimate loss.
sentences.zh: 总统不喜欢输，宁愿战斗并向他的基本盘展示他对这些问题的坚定承诺，哪怕付出最终失败的代价。

sentences.en: But the other is, let's not lose sight of Michael.
sentences.zh: 但另一个原因是，迈克尔，我们不要忽视这一点。

sentences.en: This is a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这可是件大事。

sentences.en: If this question goes on the census, it will really alter response rates.
sentences.zh: 如果这个问题被列入人口普查，它将真正改变回复率。

sentences.en: It'll alter the allocation of billions of dollars of federal funds.
sentences.zh: 它将改变数十亿美元联邦资金的分配。

sentences.en: It'll alter the allocation of congressional seats.
sentences.zh: 它将改变国会议席的分配。

sentences.en: So we've been talking about litigation maneuvers and who's telling the truth about what.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直在讨论诉讼策略以及谁在说真话。

sentences.en: But the bottom line, the larger point here, is that whatever the answer is, it's going to have a big impact on the way American democracy happens
sentences.zh: 但底线，这里更大的重点是，无论答案是什么，它都将对美国民主的运作方式

sentences.en: and the way all kinds of federal money is spent.
sentences.zh: 以及各种联邦资金的使用方式产生重大影响。

sentences.en: So the stakes are awfully high.
sentences.zh: 因此，利害关系非常重大。

sentences.en: So from the president's point of view, this is all worth it if he ultimately gets this question on the census
sentences.zh: 所以从总统的角度来看，如果他最终能把这个问题塞进人口普查，这一切都是值得的，

sentences.en: because that's a huge victory for his party and his party's future and its future power.
sentences.zh: 因为这对他所在的政党、该党未来及其未来的权力来说是一场巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: And if he loses, at least he has shown his party and his voters that he's passionate about this issue,
sentences.zh: 如果他输了，至少他向自己的政党和选民表明了他对这个问题的热情，

sentences.en: which is central to so many issues he stands for around citizenship, immigration, and power.
sentences.zh: 这对于他所代表的关于公民身份、移民和权力的许多核心问题至关重要。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我认为是这样。

sentences.en: I think this may well be a win-win for the president.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很可能是总统的双赢局面。

sentences.en: And there's a way in which the president may have already won because he's drawn so much attention to the census
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，总统可能已经赢了，因为他吸引了如此多对人口普查的关注，

sentences.en: and suggested to people who may be wary of participating in the census that it could be a dangerous thing for them,
sentences.zh: 并向那些对参与人口普查心存戒备的人暗示，这可能是一件对他们来说很危险的事情，

sentences.en: that the chances that people won't participate with or without a question may well have dropped.
sentences.zh: 无论有没有这个问题，人们不参与的概率可能已经下降了。

sentences.en: So the damage to the integrity of the census may already be done even if the Trump administration circulates a census form without the citizenship question,
sentences.zh: 因此，对人口普查完整性的破坏可能已经造成了，即使特朗普政府分发了一份没有公民身份问题的人口普查表格，

sentences.en: but people don't want to answer it either way because they're afraid of what will follow.
sentences.zh: 但人们无论如何都不想回答，因为他们害怕接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: So even if this question likely does not appear on the actual census form, immigrants might opt not to fill out the form anyway,
sentences.zh: 所以即使这个问题很可能不会出现在实际的人口普查表格上，移民们也可能会选择不填表，

sentences.en: something that would end up helping Republicans and the president.
sentences.zh: 这最终会帮助共和党人和总统。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it's possible that the president wins by actually winning in court.
sentences.zh: 所以，总统有可能通过在法庭上真正获胜而赢。

sentences.en: It's possible the president wins political points by keeping fighting and ultimately losing in court.
sentences.zh: 总统也有可能通过继续战斗并最终在法庭上败诉来赢得政治分数。

sentences.en: And it's possible that he wins his larger battle either way because he's turned the census into something that some groups think is radioactive,
sentences.zh: 无论如何，他都有可能赢得他更大的战役，因为他把人口普查变成了一些群体认为具有放射性的东西，

sentences.en: that you don't want to be associated with because no good will come of it for you.
sentences.zh: 一个你不想与之扯上关系的东西，因为它不会给你带来任何好处。

sentences.en: Adam, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 亚当，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The British ambassador to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 英国驻美大使

sentences.en: resigned on Wednesday after his candid observations about President Trump were leaked to the news media and President Trump said he would no longer work with him.
sentences.zh: 于周三辞职，此前他对特朗普总统的坦率看法被泄露给新闻媒体，且特朗普总统表示将不再与他共事。

sentences.en: The ambassador, Kim Derrick, had written a series of diplomatic cables to his superiors in London describing Trump as inept and insecure
sentences.zh: 这位大使金·达罗克曾向伦敦的上级发送了一系列外交电报，形容特朗普无能且缺乏安全感，

sentences.en: and his administration as uniquely dysfunctional.
sentences.zh: 并称他的政府有着独特的失能问题。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, this morning I have spoken to Sir Kim Derrick.
sentences.zh: 议长先生，今天早上我已经与金·达罗克爵士通了电话。

sentences.en: I have told him that it is a matter of great regret that he has felt it necessary to leave his position as ambassador in Washington.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，对于他觉得有必要离开华盛顿大使职位这一情况，我感到非常遗憾。

sentences.en: In a speech on Wednesday, British Prime Minister Theresa May defended Derrick and seemed to praise him for his honest assessment of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 英国首相特雷莎·梅周三在一次演讲中为达罗克进行了辩护，似乎赞扬了他对特朗普政府的诚实评估。

sentences.en: Good government depends on public servants being able to give full and frank advice.
sentences.zh: 好的政府取决于公务员能够提供充分而坦率的建议。

sentences.en: I want all our public servants to have the confidence to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们所有的公务员都有信心能够做到这一点。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 并且...

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: During a news conference on Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 在周三的新闻发布会上，

sentences.en: President Trump's Labor Secretary, Alexander Acosta, offered his most forceful defense yet of a 2008 agreement, which he oversaw,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的劳工部长亚历山大·阿科斯塔对他监督的一项2008年协议进行了迄今为止最有力的辩护，

sentences.en: to not bring federal charges against Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 该协议决定不对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦提起联邦指控。

sentences.en: Facts are important, and facts are being overlooked.
sentences.zh: 事实很重要，而事实正在被忽视。

sentences.en: Simply put, the Palm Beach State Attorney's Office was ready to let Epstein walk free.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，棕榈滩州检察官办公室当时准备让爱泼斯坦逍遥法外。

sentences.en: No jail time.
sentences.zh: 无需坐牢。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: Acosta said that his office reached the agreement after determining that state prosecutors were on the verge of allowing Epstein to avoid serving jail time,
sentences.zh: 阿科斯塔表示，他的办公室是在确定州检察官即将允许爱泼斯坦免服刑、

sentences.en: registering as a sex offender, or compensating his alleged victim.
sentences.zh: 免于登记为性犯罪者或免于向其受害者进行赔偿之后，才达成该协议的。

sentences.en: An account disputed by those prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 这一说法受到了这些检察官的质疑。

sentences.en: Prosecutors in my former office found this to be completely unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 我前办公室的检察官认为这是完全不可接受的。

sentences.en: Our prosecutors presented the ultimatum, plead guilty to more serious charges,
sentences.zh: 我们的检察官提出了最后通牒，要么对更严重的罪名认罪，

sentences.en: charges that require jail time, registration, and restitution, or we'd roll the dice and bring a federal indictment.
sentences.zh: 这些罪名需要判刑、登记和赔偿，要么我们就碰碰运气，提起联邦起诉。

sentences.en: Epstein eventually served just 13 months in prison, during which time he was allowed to leave during the day to work out of his office.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦最终仅在监狱服刑13个月，在此期间他被允许白天离开去办公室工作。

sentences.en: Acosta said that he recognized why people now question the agreement, which a judge has found to be illegal, but said that the agreement had followed
sentences.zh: 阿科斯塔表示，他理解为什么现在有人对该协议提出质疑，法官已经裁定该协议违法，但他表示该协议遵循了

sentences.en: Department of Justice guidelines, and that given the evidence against Epstein at the time, it was a better option than going to trial.
sentences.zh: 司法部的指导方针，鉴于当时对爱泼斯坦不利的证据，这比接受审判是更好的选择。

sentences.en: And I know that in 2019, looking back on 2008, things may look different, but this was the judgment of prosecutors with dozens of years of experience.
sentences.zh: 我知道在2019年回看2008年，情况可能会有所不同，但这是拥有数十年经验的检察官的判断。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》中，讲述了人们试图保持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
